Both show up on the cost center's sheet, as rows of their own under the entries they change.

fortnox.openingBalancesNote: Opening balances (#IB) are fetched on sync. A year synced before the balance sheet existed has to be re-synced to show the right balances.

income.title: Income
income.description: Which committee and which account a sold product belongs to — the routing table the income service uses.

export.title: Export to Fortnox
export.description: Which voucher series a day's takings are filed under.
export.seriesHint: Empty = the same series as expenses ({series}). Give it one of its own to keep takings apart.
export.seriesHintUnconnected: Empty = the same series as expenses. Fortnox is not connected yet.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Where the money lands, and what Zettle's fees cost.
accounts.clearingHint: Debited when a day's takings are booked.
accounts.feeHint: Fees are a cost and book the other way round.
accounts.feeCostCenterHint: Fees do not belong to one committee.

committees.title: Committees
committees.description: The result units, and the income settings that let them take money in. One report per verksamhet per day; the prefixes decide what goes where.
committees.name: Name
committees.empty: No result units set up yet.
committees.removeBody: The income settings and prefixes are removed. The result unit itself stays.
committees.retireBody: It has booked reports and is retired rather than removed — it stops appearing in the routing table, and the reports stay.
committees.noFallback: No prefix is marked as the fallback. Products matching nothing have nowhere to go, and fetches will be refused.

fallbacks.title: Swish amounts
fallbacks.description: Payments with no usable message are matched on the exact amount.
fallbacks.hint: The message runs through the same prefix pipeline, so "c-Cola" lands with Cafémästeriet exactly as a labelled payment would.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.description: The page could not be shown. It is usually temporary, so try again.
errorPage.notFoundDescription: The link may be wrong, or what you are looking for has been removed.

income.costCentreFailed: The cost centre could not be changed.
income.title: Income
income.description: Fetch sales from Zettle and Swish, review, and book.
income.serviceUnavailable: The income service is not configured. Set INTAKT_URL and INTAKT_TOKEN to fetch and render reports.

fetch.title: Fetch a period
fetch.description: Dates are inclusive, and read as Swedish days.

summary.alreadyBooked: {count} days were already booked and are flagged
summary.alreadyInFortnox: {count} days are already in Fortnox and are flagged
summary.fortnoxCheckFailed: Could not be checked against Fortnox

empty.description: Fetch a period from Zettle, or upload a Swish report.
empty.title: No days to book

batch.description: {count} reports — one per committee per day.

lines.accountFailed: The account could not be changed.

move.title: Move sales
move.subtitle: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} from {from}
move.mergeBody: {unit} already has a report for {date}. {count, plural, one {# item moves} other {# items move}} into it and the two days become one — they cannot be separated again.
move.dragHint: Drag onto another committee's report for the same day
move.destinationHint: The items join that committee's report for the same day. If it has none, one is created.
move.noAccounts: This committee has no product prefixes — pick an account per row.
move.stillOnOldAccount: {count, plural, one {# row is} other {# rows are}} still on the account they had in the fallback report. Is that right?
move.confirm: Move {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}
move.done: {count, plural, one {# item moved} other {# items moved}}
move.failed: The items could not be moved.

newReport.title: New report
newReport.subtitle: {date} · {source} — an empty report to move sales onto.
newReport.alreadyExists: That committee already has a report for the day. It opens instead — two reports for one day could not both be booked.
newReport.opened: That committee already had a report for the day — it is now open.
newReport.failed: The report could not be created.
newReport.emptyBody: This report holds no sales yet. Drag items onto it from another report for the same day, or select them there and choose Move. Wrong committee: delete this report and make another.
newReport.deleteBody: {unit} {date} holds no sales. The report will be removed.
newReport.deleteFailed: The report could not be deleted.

undo.unexportBody: Voucher {voucher} stays in Fortnox — this app merely stops counting the day as exported. Exporting again creates a second voucher, so reverse the first one in Fortnox first.
undo.reopenBody: The voucher and the booked income statement are deleted, and the day rejoins the To book queue. It waits there until you book it again — or until the next fetch clears the queue.
undo.deleteBody: {unit}'s report, its sold items and its voucher are removed. This cannot be undone — but fetching the same period again brings the day back.

bookAll.title: Book all?
bookAll.body: {count} reports will be booked, one at a time. Each gets an intäktsräkning and a verifikation.

review.description: Work through the days one at a time. The income statement stands beside it, the voucher is pre-filled.
review.alreadyBooked: {count} days in the period are already booked and cannot be booked again.
review.inFortnoxWarning: Fortnox already holds a voucher for this day and verksamhet ({voucher}). Only book this if they really are two separate reports.

book.unknownClearingAccount: The clearing account {account} is not in the chart of accounts. Fix it under Settings → Income before booking.
